stories.title: Your backyard could hold a rare earth fortune – and this orange lichen is the clue
stories.summary: Next time you spot a vivid orange-yellow crust spreading across a rock in your garden, on a country wall or along a hiking trail, take a closer look – you might be standing on a fortune. A Chinese research team has found that a humble lichen could serve as a visible field indicator of unknown rare earth deposits around the world. stories.title: China postpones Chang’e-7 lunar mission as conditions for launch not met: Report
stories.summary: The uncrewed spacecraft was expected to launch as early as next week to explore frozen water near the moon's south pole. The delay reflects the authorities' decision to ensure mission conditions meet required standards before proceeding. China said on Aug 23 that it has postponed its Chang’e-7 lunar mission after a “comprehensive assessment”, according to state-run Xinhua news agency. The uncrewed Chang’e-7 mission “does not meet the conditions for launch and therefore cannot be carried out within the launch window scheduled for this year”, Xinhua said, citing the authorities. Before the announcement on Aug 23, the Chang’e-7 spacecraft, named after a mythical Chinese goddess of the moon, had been expected to be launched as early as next week.

stories.title: 1,000 people in Japan help tow 400 tonne Hirosaki Castle keep closer to original position
stories.summary: About 1,000 people towed the roughly 400-tonne keep of a traditional castle in north-eastern Japan’s Aomori Prefecture on Aug 23, moving it 109cm closer to its original position, after it was relocated 11 years ago. The keep of Hirosaki Castle, a national historical treasure in the city of the same name, was moved in 2015 to repair the stone walls that supported it. By the end of 2026, it will be moved about 78m to where it was. About 1,000 people chosen by lottery were divided into groups, pulling a cart carrying the keep with ropes. A total of 4,000 people are scheduled to participate in similar events between Aug 29 and 30, with the aim of moving the keep about 5m in total.
